title: Camera with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- camera body -->
  <rect x='14' y='34' width='72' height='46' rx='8' fill='#4a9fe0'/>
  <rect x='14' y='34' width='72' height='46' rx='8' fill='none' stroke='#a8dcf5' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- top hump / viewfinder -->
  <rect x='30' y='24' width='26' height='14' rx='4' fill='#3a7fc0'/>
  <rect x='30' y='24' width='26' height='14' rx='4' fill='none' stroke='#a8dcf5' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- shutter button -->
  <rect x='66' y='26' width='12' height='8' rx='3' fill='#ffd44a'/>
  <!-- lens -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='20' fill='#2b5f99'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='20' fill='none' stroke='#a8dcf5' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='13' fill='#6ec8ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='7' fill='#d6f2ff'/>
  <!-- little smiley on the lens -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='55' r='1.8' fill='#2b5f99'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='55' r='1.8' fill='#2b5f99'/>
  <path d='M46 61 Q50 65 54 61' fill='none' stroke='#2b5f99' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- flash -->
  <rect x='20' y='30' width='12' height='7' rx='2' fill='#f0f7ff'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks on body -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='70' r='4' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='70' r='4' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <rect x='28' y='80' width='12' height='7' rx='3' fill='#3a7fc0'/>
  <rect x='60' y='80' width='12' height='7' rx='3' fill='#3a7fc0'/>
</svg>
